pages.excerpt: The**Maltese Government 2022–2026**was the[Government of Malta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government_of_Malta)([Maltese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maltese_language):*Il-Gvern ta' Malta*) from 30 March 2022 until 2026. It is the second ministry of[Prime Minister](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_Minister_of_Malta)[Robert Abela](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Abela). The Maltese government is elected through a General Election for a five-year term. The[Labour Party](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Labour_Party_(Malta))(*Partit Laburista*) won a majority following a[general election which was held on 26 March 2022](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_Maltese_general_election).[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maltese_Government_2022%E2%80%932026#cite_note-1)The cabinet and parliamentary secretaries for this legislature were initially sworn in on 30 March 2022.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maltese_Government_2022%E2%80%932026#cite_note-2)Abela has reshuffled his cabin
